sonnet.problem: The joke is about Noah being past 600 and Papa Dorin groaning from age. That is an age joke about a Bible person. It also gives Papa Dorin an age, and he is meant to have none.
sonnet.rule: Never puts down any person or group: no jokes about age, gender, race, nationality, accents, appearance, intelligence or church denomination. This includes Bible people and places

sonnet.problem: Card 8 already asks how Shem and Japheth reach their father, and the answer is that they walk backward. Card 9 asks about the same point from verse 23: their faces were turned away so they did not see. That is one point asked twice.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: Card 14 has just asked what God may do for Japheth and shown the answer, expanded territory. Card 15 then retells that same line as a story card. It is effectively a recap of the answered question and adds only a joke.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
